items.definition:
a formal inquiry or systematic examination
The police launched an investigation into the crime.

behavior involving physical force intended to hurt, damage, or kill someone or something
The film contained scenes of extreme violence.

the highest legislature, consisting of the sovereign, the House of Lords, and the House of Commons
The new law was debated in parliament.

the action of mentioning or alluding to something
Please provide a reference for your claims.

a plan of action
We need a clear strategy to win the game.

the central or most important part
The core of the problem is a lack of communication.

the state of being present
Her presence made everyone feel calm.

the maximum amount that something can contain
The hall has a seating capacity of 500 people.

a moral or legal obligation
It is your duty to report any suspicious activity.

elected head of a state
The governor signed the new bill into law.

strong metal alloy
The bridge is made of steel.

immoral behavior, bad habit
Smoking is a common vice.

an order
The general gave a command to advance.

a component, a basic part
Trust is a key element in any relationship.

ability to acquire and apply knowledge
She showed great intelligence in solving the problem.

lawyer
The attorney presented the case to the judge.

money owed
He is trying to pay off his debt.

high respect
It was an honor to meet him.

a matter or concern
It's a private affair.

a serious or urgent request
The charity launched an appeal for donations.

a long and distinct period of history
We are living in a new digital era.

a circumstance, fact, or influence that contributes to a result
Cost was a major factor in our decision.

a sum of money given for a specific purpose
The university received a research grant.

a plan or course of action taken to achieve a particular purpose
We need to take strong measures to reduce pollution.

small group of people
The police squad arrived quickly.

cruel or violent treatment
The report detailed cases of child abuse.

a place or building
The new sports facility is impressive.

a part or division
The technology sector is growing rapidly.

finance
He works in the field of finance.

identity
She is trying to find her true identity.

aircraft
The aircraft landed safely on the runway.

conflict
There was a conflict of interest.

debate
The candidates held a public debate.

distribution
The company handles the distribution of goods.

a stage in a process
The project is currently in its final phase.

something that is needed or demanded
Meeting all the requirements is essential for graduation.

income, especially from a company's activities
The company's revenue increased significantly last quarter.

a group of soldiers or people
The troops were deployed to the affected area.

the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea
You need to understand the historical context of the speech.

the extent to which something is covered
The news coverage of the event was extensive.

mode
Please switch your phone to silent mode.

surgery
She had to undergo emergency surgery.

vision
His vision for the company was ambitious.

crisis
The country is facing an economic crisis.

editor
She works as an editor for a publishing company.

jail
He was sent to jail for his crime.

literature
She studies English literature at university.

selection
There was a wide selection of books.

struggle
It was a long struggle to achieve their goals.

a group of people gathered together; the action of assembling
The school held a special assembly for the new students.

a preliminary version; a current of cool air
This is the first draft of my essay.

a university teacher; a Mafia boss
He was a respected don at Oxford University.

a state in which supreme power is held by the people and their elected representatives
France is a republic.

a supply of something kept for future use
The country has large oil reserves.

a piece of numerical data
The latest statistics show a rise in unemployment.

a thing used to tie or bind something
They formed a strong bond over the years.

a fact or condition connected with or relevant to an event or action
Under no circumstances should you open that door.

a large company or group of companies authorized to act as a single entity
She works for a large multinational corporation.

a small cut or notch
He got a small nick on his chin while shaving.

a firm decision; a solution
He made a New Year's resolution to exercise more.

all existing matter and space
Scientists study the origins of the universe.

the abode of God or the gods; a place of supreme happiness
The view from the mountain top was like a piece of heaven.

freedom from external control or support
The country celebrated its independence day.

an established organization or foundation
The university is a respected educational institution.
